title: Psychedelic Mermaid Vortex
description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring a stylized mermaid with a vibrant green serpentine tail and long flowing purple hair. She emerges from swirling, hypnotic vortex patterns in bright turquoise, magenta, blue, and lime, surrounded by floating bubbles and small silhouetted figures.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic mermaid with a long flowing green serpentine tail and dark purple hair adorned with glowing circles, positioned in the center of a vibrant swirling vortex of blue, magenta, turquoise and lime patterns. Small silhouetted figures float inside bubbles throughout the composition. Whimsical, hypnotic, highly detailed digital painting with smooth flowing lines and vibrant color transitions.
